name: Marvel Rivals
short_description: Six-versus-six hero shooter with Marvel characters and destructible maps.
sources: oracle study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no store fetch, no game files)
summary: Six-versus-six hero shooter with Marvel characters and destructible maps.

identity.core_loop: Pick a hero, combine team-ups, take or hold the objective.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: Heroes' shapes and colours identify them; team-up icons over allies (spatial).

rendering.signature: Comic-book shading with crisp light bands and outlines that thin with distance.
rendering.source: oracle rendering study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no captures, no game files)
rendering.lesson: Outline width should follow distance and importance, not stay one fixed pixel width.

identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: Team-ups: two characters together unlock something new. Great for animal pairings.

review: Bright, loud and generous. The idea worth keeping is team-ups: when two particular heroes are near each other they gain a joint power.
